about: This Secret asks that Saint Athanasius’s annual feast make the petitioners pleasing to God. It then asks for a blessed reward both to attend the saint and to obtain gifts of grace for the petitioners through the present acts of propitiation.

s01.translation: We pray, Lord: may the annual feast of Saint Athanasius, Your confessor and bishop, make us pleasing to Your goodness, so that through these acts of devout propitiation a blessed reward may both attend him and obtain for us the gifts of Your grace. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

alignments.gloss: through these acts of devout propitiation
a blessed reward may both attend him
obtain for us the gifts of Your grace
who lives and reigns with You

w010.explanation: The annual feast is the subject of “reddat.” The petitioners are to be made pleasing to God.

w025.explanation: The blessed reward is the subject of both verbs that follow. Athanasius is the person it is asked to attend.

w032.explanation: The same blessed reward is asked to obtain gifts for us. The saint and the petitioners are not interchangeable recipients.

w049.explanation: God describes Christ, the Son, not the Father being addressed. The Son lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
